items.source: Note: CallbackFilter implementations are supposed to be lightweight as cglib might keep CallbackFilter objects alive to enable caching of generated classes. Prefer using static classes for implementation of CallbackFilter.
items.translation: 注意：`CallbackFilter` 实现应该是轻量级的，因为 cglib 可能会保留 `CallbackFilter` 对象以启用生成类的缓存。建议优先使用 `static` 类来实现 `CallbackFilter`。

items.source: The CallbackFilter in use affects which cached class the Enhancer will use, so this is a reminder that you should correctly implement equals and hashCode for custom CallbackFilter implementations in order to improve performance.
items.translation: 正在使用的 `CallbackFilter` 会影响 `Enhancer` 将使用哪个缓存类，因此这是一个提醒：您应为自定义的 `CallbackFilter` 实现正确实现 `equals` 和 `hashCode`，以提高性能。

items.source: Map a method to a callback.
the index into the array of callbacks (as specified by Enhancer.setCallbacks(Callback[])) to use for the method,
items.translation: 用于该方法的回调数组索引（如由Enhancer.setCallbacks(Callback[])指定），

items.translation: `equals` 在类 `Object` 中
